summary: Refactor of _fallback_publish does not introduce any new attack surface. Secret handling adheres to the existing redaction protocol: log lines use `type(exc).__name__` (Decision 12 pattern) so a Claude exception containing the API key cannot leak via either the warning log or the admin-ping path. The `sanitize_error_message(state_err)` call on the outage_state failure path inherits the existing _SECRET_ENV_NAMES list (which already includes ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). Admin-ping payloads are routed through `send_admin_notification`, which itself runs the message through `_redact_text` (Decision 12 belt-and-suspenders). No new SQL, no new HTTP calls — the refactor only changes which translation engine runs, not how downstream IO is performed.
owasp_dimensions_checked: A02:2021 — Cryptographic Failures (secret leakage in logs / admin chat)
A03:2021 — Injection (SQL queries via outage_state) — no new SQL added in news_bot
A04:2021 — Insecure Design (degraded-mode behaviour cannot leave the channel offline)
A09:2021 — Security Logging and Monitoring Failures (admin pings on outage)

findings.location: news_bot.py:838-854 — exception type only in log message
findings.finding: Both fallback paths log `type(exc).__name__` — never `str(exc)`. This matches Decision 12 of the feature spec. Even if the Anthropic SDK accidentally embedded the API key in an exception string, our log lines would not propagate it.
findings.suggested_action: None — flagged as a positive observation.
findings.rationale: Strength: tightest possible log discipline for the outage path.

findings.location: news_bot.py:870-878 — admin ping dispatch on outage
findings.finding: Admin pings come from `outage_state.record_outage_event` which returns canonical fixed Russian strings (defined as module-level constants in outage_state.py). No user-controlled data flows into the admin-ping payload — even if the outage was caused by a malicious-looking exception, the ping text is one of three pre-baked strings. `send_admin_notification` further redacts via `_redact_text`. Defense-in-depth holds.

`record_outage_event` is documented in outage_state.py as `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` with `PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000`. Two concurrent fallback-publish callers serialize via the SQLite write lock — no double-increment of ping_count. Refactor preserves this invariant by calling the helper at the natural single-row granularity.

Defensive `.get(...) or ''` patterns on title/subtitle and `list(... or [])` on paragraphs guard against a malformed Claude response slipping through as None values into Telegraph. Even though `claude_transcreation._parse_response` validates the schema strictly, this surface-level defense is good belt-and-suspenders.
